title.suggested: Portrait of Tom Allen Taken After the McCoole Fight

summary.suggested: The Daily Missouri Democrat noted a full-length photograph of Allen in fighting costume by Louis Umber, taken the day after his fight with McCoole, on sale at the Book and News Company on Fourth Street.

metadata.notes: masthead reads Daily Democrat, Friday Morning, June 25, 1869

facts.fact: Photographer Louis Umber took a full-length portrait of Allen in fighting costume the day after the McCoole fight; copies with an account of his battles were sold at the Book and News Company, Fourth Street
places: Book and News Company, Fourth Street, St. Louis

notes: Photographer's first name is partly unclear in the image; 'Louis' is the likely reading.
